description: A statement that is not block-like ends with `;`; a line break does not end it (`const a = n + 1⏎return a;`). The missing `;` is E-STMT-MISSING-SEMICOLON (§7.2.2 rule 1, S469).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐⭐⭐ RULED — dpa-073 F1 = (a)" — `;` terminates; newlines carry no grammar · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐ RULED — statement termination follow-ups, §7.2.2" item 1 (the termination code confirmed)
rationale: §7.2.2 rule 1: every non-block-like statement SHALL end with `;`, and a statement with no `;` is E-STMT-MISSING-SEMICOLON. impl#1 does not enforce `;` (dpa-073 F5: a carried, impl#1-labelled divergence, g-dpa063-termination-unbuilt-impl1-legacy); the bootstrap does.
